description: L0005臺南市山崩與地滑地質敏感區劃定計畫書 [landslides and debris flows] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. L0005臺南市山崩與地滑地質敏感區劃定計畫書圖文件，說明劃定依據、劃定方式及劃定參考資料等相關資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
